config.direction_definition: business direction uses end-to-end source/destination; each hop direction uses its link endpoints (forward u<v, backward u>v); replay must use hop direction

skr_model.skr_reference: User-supplied SKR_new.py: BB84_SKR_finite; adapted with existing detector and loss parameters
skr_model.skr_definition: Time mean of per-channel nonnegative finite-size two-decoy BB84 estimates on the selected link; bit/pulse multiplied by pulse rate once
skr_model.raw_skr_definition: Pre-clipping finite-size expression when bounds are admissible; zero when bounds fail; diagnostic only, not usable key rate
skr_model.skr_block_definition: Each sampled resource state is held stationary for the configured pulse block; block duration=N/rate_hz; independent of simulation slots and holding time; not key extraction from a time-varying collected block
skr_model.skr_security_scope: Gaussian fluctuation estimate on weak-decoy gain/error counts; signal gain and vacuum yield use model expectations; no composable epsilon security claim or phase-error finite-size proof
skr_model.skr_noise_definition: Existing detector-adjusted per-gate noise used as per-detector background probability, following supplied reference; Y0=1-(1-dark_count-noise)^2; no repeated efficiency/loss conversion

config.metric_reference: Classical OSNR and synergy magnitude adapted from KeyConsumption_24node -7 core; distance-dependent SKR bounds use supplied SKR_new.py finite-size estimator
config.skr_reference: User-supplied SKR_new.py: BB84_SKR_finite; adapted with existing detector and loss parameters

config.metric_scope: One selected undirected link; classical traffic routed and allocated across the full network
config.osnr_definition: Single-link adaptation of reference business entry: mean received signal / (mean XT + 3.21e-9 W), one hop; linear time mean over nonempty slot ends, then dB
config.osnr_db_definition: 10*log10 of seed mean linear OSNR; across seeds report mean and sample SD of seed dB values
config.classical_noise_model: Reference XT only: nearest 1e-6 and second-nearest 1e-7 km^-1; retain reference victim-power gating for backward XT; fixed floor 3.21e-9 W per occupied channel
config.osnr_idle_definition: Empty slots excluded; all-idle window is null; occupied zero-XT slots remain finite due to reference floor
config.synergy_definition: M=sqrt(abs(Uc_A-Uc_FF)*abs(Uq_A-Uq_FF)); S=+M if OSNR_A>OSNR_FF and SKR_A>SKR_FF else -M; zero magnitude returns 0; Uc=(OSNR-C_alpha)/(C_beta-C_alpha); Uq=(SKR-Q_lower)/(Q_upper-Q_lower)
config.synergy_reference: C_alpha=receive_power(power,L)/(6*forward_P_XT(1e-6,L,power)+3.21e-9); C_beta=receive_power(power,L)/3.21e-9; power is actual launch power per core/channel in W; one hop
config.synergy_skr_bounds: Q_upper=BB84_SKR(L,0); Q_lower=mean per-channel BB84_SKR(L,noise_power_to_counts((N_classical-1)*forward_P_XT(1e-6,L,P_launch),f_q,detector)); same finite-key and detector parameters as actual SKR
config.synergy_classical_core_definition: Count unique cores in union of forward/backward classical core sets
config.synergy_skr_bound_units: SKR bit/s; distance m; launch and XT power W; coupling 1e-6 km^-1; noise counts per gate; no historical SDM half factor
config.synergy_undefined: Missing OSNR or nonpositive SKR normalization span yields null
config.synergy_interpretation: Positive only for strict improvement in both OSNR and SKR; otherwise negative when magnitude is nonzero; equality in either metric gives zero; no clipping, no guaranteed absolute bound of 1; not a percentage gain; sign assigned per paired seed before averaging
config.cca_experiment_policy: Three-core adaptation: quantum core 0; forward [1,2,3]; backward [4,5,6]; ascending actual frequency; disjoint directions, not reference six-core shared CCA
config.synergy_baseline_resource_policy: Three-core binding; disjoint directional groups; ascending actual frequency
config.greedy_objective: Minimum incremental Raman + FWM optical power at quantum receivers (W); no safety tiers or parity/separation priority
